chapter.verse: Hih thute khit ciangin mang sungah Topa ’ thu Abram’ tungah hong tung a, Abram aw, lau kei in, keimah in nangma' lum ka hi hi; na thaman lian mahmah ding hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abram in, “ Topa PASIAN aw, bang hong pia ding na hi hiam? Ta nei loin ka om lai hi, ka inn a luah dingpa in Damaskas mi Eliezer ahi hi.
Ta nong pia kei a, ka inn sunga a suak sila in keima gamhluah hi ding hi,” ci hi.
En in, ama tungah Topa ’ thu hong tung a, “Hih mipa in nangma gamhluahpa hilo ding hi; nangma' tapa mahmah na gamhluahpa hi ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah in a pua lamah paipih a, “Vantung lam enin aksite sim in, na sim zo hiam?” ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Na suan-le-khakte tua mah bang ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah in Topa um hi; tua ahih manin ahi ding bangin Abram gamta hi, ci-in Topa in ciamteh hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah, “Hih leitang na neih nadinga nangma’ tungah a hong pia dingin Khaldea gam Ur khua panin a hong paikhiatpihpa in keimah Topa ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “ Topa PASIAN aw, keimah in tua ka neih nading bangci theih ding ka hi hiam?” ci hi.
Amah in, “Kum thum a pha bawngla khat, kum thum a pha keelnu khat, kum thum a pha tuutal khat, vakhu khat leh kawl vakhu khang lai khat hong paipih in,” ci hi.
Amah in ama' kiangah hihte khempeuh paipih a, tuate phel nih suahin, phel khat pen a phel khat tungah koih ciat hi; ahih hangin vasate phel nih suah lo hi.
Sasialne vasate tua sate' tungah hong tuksuk ciangin Abram in tuate hawlkhia hi.
Ni a tum ciangin Abram a ihmut nak suah mahmah hi; en in, ama' tungah a kihtakhuai khuamial sahpi om hi.

Tua ciangin Topa in Abram kiangah, “Na suan-le-khakte amau’ leitang ahi lo munah tawl khat omin, tua lai-ah amaute sila hi ding uh a, amaute kum zali sung kinengniam ding a hihna thu a kitel theihna thei in;
ahih hangin na a sepsak uh minam’ tungah thukhenna ka tungsak ding a, tua khit ciangin neihsa tampi tawh amaute paikhia ding uh hi.
Nangma pumpi ading ahih leh, nuamtakin na pate’ kiang na zuan ding hi; nang pen khan’ kicingin hong kivui ding hi.
Khang lina ciangin hih lai munah amaute hong paikik ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Amor mite’ mawhna kicing nai lo hi,” ci hi.
Ni tumin khua a mial khit ciangin, en in, hih sate kikal-ah mei beel khu leh a kuang meivak pai hi.
Tua ni-in Topa in Abram tawh thuciamna khat bawl a, “Na suan-le-khakte tungah hih leitang, Izipt gun panin a lian gunpi ahi Eufrates gun ciang dong,
Ken mite, Kenaz mite, Kadmon mite
Hit mite, Perez mite, Refaim mite,
Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Girgash mite leh Jebus mite’ leitang ka pia hi,” ci hi.
